notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.provsql: The data is loaded before the clock, as a database holds its data; the time is the queries'.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; noisyor6_9.dice.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(define complement?
  (not (member "--no-complement" (vector->list (current-command-line-arguments)))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)

;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))

    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))

;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))
